name: neorgon-forge
description: Skills for finding your way into hard work, taking it on, and then explaining it. wayfind maps an unfamiliar codebase and resolves tickets to files; untangle works a problem whose shape is not yet known; atlas extracts a dependency model and generates MkDocs pages and Mermaid diagrams from it, then answers questions against it; task scopes and delegates; debrief turns the result into a deck; writeup turns it into a published post; deckcraft writes and repairs the decks that do not come from a diff, holding every heading to a claim someone could dispute; voicecheck keeps the copy consistent; penname drafts new prose in English or Spanish under a corpus-derived persona, lints it against checkable register rules, and keeps a feedback ledger of the corrections the author actually accepted; groundwork investigates a tutorial's prerequisites, credentials, and limits and dates every claim — then docrun.sh executes the doc's own commands to prove them and stale.sh expires them; quizmaster turns source material into a validated Proctor-format exam; mascot-forge generates a character and rigs it; secret-safe-reporting designs pipelines that report on sensitive data without leaking it. task, debrief and writeup share one brief written during the work, so the account of it is a record rather than a recollection.
